_notes: Copy the object inside "entry" into master.json → courses[<your course>].testSeries (add a comma after the previous test).
id must equal testId in the questions file. questionsUrl is the file path under public/ (starts with /data/questions/).
totalQuestions = number of questions. maxScore = sum of all question marks (including essays).
difficulty: Easy | Medium | Hard.  isFree: true shows 'Start Test', false shows the locked Premium button.
img: optional. Use a wide image (about 800x400) — local file like /images/my-test.jpg or a full https URL. null = colour banner.
markingScheme: optional. Only add it if this test's marking differs from the course; you can give just the values that change.

entry.title: Your Test Title
entry.description: One or two lines about what this test covers
